top_signals.title: German drone maker Helsing enlists Rakuten to broker Japan military deal
top_signals.summary: Japan's Ground Self-Defense Force is currently ​testing Helsing's HX-2 strike drone, as Tokyo looks to modernize its military and counter ‌an increasingly ‌assertive China.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Rights group urges FIFA to block Infantino reelection bid over term limits
top_signals.summary: Infantino in 2022 successfully argued that his first spell in charge should not count toward the football body's three-term limit because it completed an interrupted mandate.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trump promised a sex-trafficking crackdown. His Justice Department hasn’t delivered.
top_signals.summary: Investigations have stalled and prosecutions have declined because of staffing shortages, funding cuts, immigration enforcement and growing distrust of the government.
